questions.question: How should the 6 findings for PR #1173 get onto the PR?

options.label: Post via gh api (Recommended)
options.description: I post them from this session as one COMMENT review with 6 inline comments at the anchored lines, then check the count. This is outward-facing and visible on the PR, and it's allowed because the skill lets the caller post.

options.label: Reconnect MCP, re-run
options.description: You connect the GitHub MCP server and re-run /rvw-pr 1173 so it posts through the normal path. That costs a full new review pass, which may produce different findings.

options.label: Don't post, fix directly
options.description: Skip posting and fix the 6 findings on this branch now. Nothing is recorded on the PR for /fix-pr or ship-report to count.
